project.title: QWEN: Aplikasi AI Gratis yang Lagi Viral

scenes.voiceover: Agar aapko ek aisa AI tool mil jaye jo bina paise diye aapka kaam minutes mein kar de, to kya aap use try karenge?
scenes.onScreenText: Free AI tool jo aapka kaam minutes mein kar de?
scenes.visualPrompt: Create a vertical 9:16 attention-grabbing visual related to QWEN, a viral free AI tool.

scenes.voiceover: Is AI tool ka naam QWEN hai, aur ye abhi kaafi viral ho raha hai.
scenes.visualPrompt: Create a modern vertical 9:16 AI technology visual representing QWEN AI, futuristic interface, mobile-first social media style.

scenes.voiceover: Sabse interesting baat ye hai ki aap isse writing, ideas aur kai daily tasks ke liye use kar sakte hain.
scenes.visualPrompt: Create a vertical 9:16 visual showing AI helping with writing, ideas and everyday productivity tasks.

scenes.voiceover: Agar aap AI tools explore kar rahe hain, to QWEN ko ek baar try karna worth hai.
scenes.onScreenText: AI Tools Explore Kar Rahe Ho?
scenes.visualPrompt: Create a premium vertical 9:16 social media visual showing a person discovering a powerful AI productivity tool.

scenes.voiceover: Aise hi useful AI tools ke liye follow karna mat bhoolna.
scenes.visualPrompt: Create a vertical 9:16 high-energy social media follow call-to-action visual related to AI tools.
